art_prompt: Retro tarot card style illustration, ornate mystical border frame, swim goggles and lane rope icon centered, small celestial stars and crescent moon accents, muted vintage colors navy, gold, cream, dusty rose, text arched inside the card frame above and below the central icon
title: Swim Mom Tarot Card Shirt, Funny Swim Meet Tee, Retro Mystic Design, Swim Team Parent Gift
description:
Part fortune card, part survival badge, this design captures the never-ending cycle of early meets and endless bleacher hours in one striking graphic. A fresh, fun spin on standard swim mom merch.

The mystical tarot-inspired frame stands out in a sea of plain text shirts, making it an easy scroll-stopper for gift shopping or team spirit wear.

Soft, comfortable fit that's ready for early call times and long meet days. Design created by our shop with the help of AI tools and printed on demand by our production partner.
risk_notes: Original tarot-inspired illustration with no references to real tarot brands or copyrighted card designs.

brief.why: Despite 3096 active listings, a brand-new 13-day-old listing already hit mom=0.53 and a tarot-card design listing hit 605 lifetime favorites, showing real appetite for a fresher comedic/visual hook in a crowded but not hopeless space.
